profile.title: Set up your profile

requirements.spamControl: Nickname alone cannot filter spam sign-ups, so nickname, field tags, and bio are mandatory.

errors.nickname: Enter a nickname of at least 2 characters.
errors.tags: Choose at least one field tag.
errors.nicknameRejected: The server rejected this nickname. Check the rules above.
errors.bioRejected: The server rejected this bio. Keep it under 1000 characters.

saveErrors.network: We couldn't save your profile. Check your connection and try again.
saveErrors.session: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
saveErrors.NICKNAME_TAKEN: That nickname is already in use. Choose another one.
saveErrors.invalid: Check every field: the nickname must be 2-50 characters, and a bio and field tag are required.
saveErrors.INVALID_CHARACTER: Your nickname or bio contains characters that cannot be saved (for example a NUL byte). Remove them and try again.
saveErrors.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Your account record could not be found. Reload the page or sign in again.
saveErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
saveErrors.generic: We couldn't save your profile. Please try again.
saveErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

form.nicknameHint: 2–50 characters: letters (with their accent or vowel marks), digits, _ . -; starting and ending with a letter or digit.
form.signInAgain: Sign in again (your entries are kept)

nicknameErrors.reserved: This word is reserved. Choose another nickname.
nicknameErrors.chars: Use only letters (with their accent or vowel marks), digits, and _ . - (no spaces).
nicknameErrors.marks: Combining marks must follow a letter or digit, at most 3 in a row.
nicknameErrors.lookalike: Full-width and math-style letters are not allowed. Use plain letters.
nicknameErrors.mixedScript: Don't mix Latin letters with Cyrillic or Greek ones.
nicknameErrors.edge: Start and end with a letter or digit.
nicknameErrors.staticExtension: Nicknames can't end with a file extension like .js.
